Node.js has a built-in REPL with syntax highlighting. Its continuation prompt is `|`:

```yaml
extensions:
  term:
    shell: node
    prompt: "`>`"
    ps2: "|"
```

## Basic Usage

```{term}
console.log("Hello from Node.js " + process.version)
```

## Expressions

```{term}
1 + 1
Math.PI * 2
```

## Objects and Arrays

```{term}
const data = {name: "quarto-term", version: "0.4.3", shells: 10}
data
[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(x => x * x)
```

## Functions

```{term}
function fibonacci(n) {
  if (n <= 1) return n;
  return fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2);
}
Array.from({length: 10}, (_, i) => fibonacci(i))
```

## Promises

```{term}
await Promise.all([1, 2, 3].map(x => Promise.resolve(x * 10)))
```
